mapper.sql: id, part_name, part_code, standard_id, parameters, is_qualified, inspection_time, inspection_details, inspection_suggestion, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parts (part_name, part_code, standard_id, parameters) VALUES (#{partName}, #{partCode}, #{standardId}, #{parameters})
mapper.update: UPDATE parts SET part_name = #{partName}, part_code = #{partCode}, standard_id = #{standardId}, parameters = #{parameters}, is_qualified = #{isQualified}, inspection_time = #{inspectionTime}, inspection_details = #{inspectionDetails}, inspection_suggestion = #{inspectionSuggestion} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE parts SET is_qualified = #{isQualified}, inspection_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, inspection_details = #{inspectionDetails}, inspection_suggestion = #{inspectionSuggestion}, inspection_flag = 1 WHERE id = #{partId}
